newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares end just off shortened session high.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares end just off shortened session high.

text.p: 1510 GMT - Italian shares which opened at 1200 GMT after a four-hour delay due to a technical hitch closed just off the day's highs boosted by subdued U.S. August CPI data which allayed fears of a need for a new Fed rate rise, traders said.

Stocks languishing in recent sessions gained sharply on widespread shortcovering. "It was a session which allowed us to get our breath back even if it might just be all down to a simple technical correction," one dealer said.
* All-share Mibtel index closed 1.97 percent up at 9,624 after late high of 9,630. Mib30 blue chip index up 2.49 percent at 14,400 after touching 14,424.
